description: Compare the carrier local +Z normal to head position in the retained observations. Opening anchor rotation was identity to sample precision.
finding: The overhead view is nearly face-on when closed but nearly edge-on after opening; future staging should account for the open carrier normal.
limits: Native and rendered pose publications are not proven atomic.
Angles are geometric estimates, not proof of visibility, collision-free reach or acceptable cinematography.
